units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 11:4">Sabb. XI, 4</cite> <he>אם היה רְקַק מים וכ׳</he> if there is a pool (on the shore), and the public road crosses it; <he>וכמה הוא ר׳ מים</he>, and how deep must it be to be called a pool? <cite ref="Eruvin 43a:14">Erub. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>במהלכת בר׳</he> when the ship moves in diluvial water.

<cite ref="Chullin 27b:12">Ḥull. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>מן הר׳ נבראו</he> birds were created out of alluvial mud; <cite ref="Eruvin 28a">Erub. 28ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:4">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>דגי ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="L00262"><he>לִוְיָתָן</he></cite>; a. e.
